children: Lindblad Expeditions entered into a Sale and Purchase Agreement to acquire a 60% controlling interest in White Desert, PNR Airways, and Echo Charlie, expanding its Antarctic expedition and aviation capabilities. The approximately $61 million cash deal includes about $6 million for cash on the balance sheet and customary working capital, cash, and debt adjustments. Lindblad also secured two options to buy the remaining interests in equal tranches within 30 days of December 31, 2030 and 2031 at prices based on the businesses’ EBITDA.
